body:
Add nativeProsecute option (and ADLC_NATIVE_PROSECUTE=0 env var) in plugins/adlc-opencode/index.mjs to skip registering adlc_prosecute with a one-line log notice, and remove the Prefer this over orchestrating the prosecution by hand sentence from buildProsecuteTool description in plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecute-tool.mjs.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Setting nativeProsecute: false or ADLC_NATIVE_PROSECUTE=0 omits adlc_prosecute from registered tools and logs once. Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/plugin-options.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/v2-registration.test.mjs
2. Default behavior still registers adlc_prosecute without the Prefer this over orchestrating phrase in its description. Verify: node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/prosecute-tool.test.mjs
title: opencode: allow disabling adlc_prosecute and drop prefer-this wording (#1183)
